repository.source_digest_definition: SHA-256 of sorted Git tracked and nonignored untracked filenames, modes and file SHA-256s; symlinks record link text

benchmark.cold_definition: decompressed chunk cache disabled; OS page cache is uncontrolled, not disk-cold
benchmark.kind: direct range resolver benchmark (not mounted I/O)
benchmark.native_filesystem_compression_baseline: Windows WOF measurement required; not available on this OS
benchmark.physical_bytes_definition: sum of encoded store file lengths; allocated_bytes measures POSIX blocks separately

update.definition: hypothetical shared-object update: missing v2 payloads + complete v2 metadata + one pack header; stores are independently published, no delta-update API or allocation claim

inspection.measurement_note: full identity hash and at most three 64 KiB Zstd level 3 probes per file; scanner hints are untrusted; no already-compressed byte attribution
